text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross hasn't shown up for 
training... Just as that thought crosses 
my mind—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I thought I oughtta get a proper meal in 
before workin' out, but I ended up 
orderin' way too much.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I was stuffed halfway through, ya know? 
Still, can't go leavin' any on the plate, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I managed to finish it all, but it took 
way too long... I'm real sorry! Please 
forgive me!

Knowing that Tamamo Cross has a small 
appetite, and seeing that she seemed 
genuinely remorseful, I let the matter go 
with just a light warning.
